subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure among the given options that replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2385cb28365e95274b37743a0620d6129d5afa1f1a385284a91cfdf140bfba42.png]
solution:
The figure among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a8823ab9cbe4d0039abaebb1f974cc4082318569c048652336338448e12c5d8.png] 

The emoji is changing its position in anti-clockwise direction.

The heart shape is changing its position in clockwise direction and moving itself in clockwise direction while changing its position.

The vertical line increases by one as we move along the series.

Hence, '**option 3**' is the correct answer.
